title: Bookmark window
idea: The bookmark first: a smaller play hole set in Shelf's bookmark like a window, with a broad margin of paper all round and the paper pause held snugly inside it. Of the three it keeps the most solid bookmark, so saving reads before listening.
built: Same bookmark as n1 (43.5 dp wide, top at 27.1, reach 32.6 dp). The play is equilateral, 32.3 dp tall, corners at the shoulder radius, sized so at least 7.5 dp of paper stays round it: 7.5 over the notch, 9 at the top corner, 10.4 on the left and 10.2 past the drawn tip. The band over the notch is the thinnest on purpose, because the tails add paper either side of it. The play's centroid is at (52, 48.5), on the bookmark's visual centre, which sits lower than the middle of the body above the notch; centred on the body, the play looked high. The pause sits on the incircle (radius 9.3 dp): bars 3.3 x 10 dp, 2.8 dp apart, inside a 3 dp ring, tighter than n1's 4 dp, so the island keeps its size in the smaller play.
small: 48 px: bookmark 28 x 34 px with a 20 px play and 4.8 to 7 px of paper round it; no pause, as the play's incircle is under 6 px in radius. 32 px: a 14 px play with 3.4 to 5 px of paper; no pause. 16 px: the same 4 x 7 px stepped play as n1. Glyph 24: an 11 px play hole with at least 3.3 px of white round it; no pause. In the 48, the 32 and the glyph the play's ends sit on half pixels so the paper above and below it keeps the master's ratio; the play has no level edge, so nothing blurs.
risks: The quietest of the three, and the nearest to a bookmark with a play badge placed on it, the clip-art reading the brief warns against. Its pause is the smallest here and turns to specks on a 1x home screen, and its play window is small in the 32 and 16 px cuts. It shares n1's likeness to Google Play Books, at a lower volume.
